newsitem.title: JORDAN: Jordanian market mixed in end of weekly trade.
newsitem.headline: Jordanian market mixed in end of weekly trade.

text.p: Shares on the Amman stock exchange rose 0.21 percent at end of weekly trade on Wednesday, dominated by a large bloc sale in Arab Bank, brokers said.
The official Amman Financial Market (AFM) index rose 0.32 points to 156.08 points in turnover of 1,055,980 dinars ($1.4 million), a bloc sale in Arab Bank accounting for half of the daily volume.
"The market has continued to underperform this week with a poor sentiment still weighing down on the market," said one broker.
Arab Bank fell 0.50 dinars to 266.00 dinars in trade worth 572,660 dinars, making the most heavily traded share on Wednesday.
Cairo Amman Bank, which was unchanged to 5.00 dinars and Jordan Cement Factories which rose 0.06 dinars to 3.46 dinars, were the two busiest stock in otherwise lacklustre trade.
Overall nine shares fell, nine rose and 19 traded without changing.
The private Pearl Index of the 45 most-traded shares on the exchange rose 0.07 percent to 81.76 points.
